messages:
elaine: heads up — bringing up HF model 'phi-bert-vert' via hf-converter, loader errored. conversion produced tokenizer_config.json but no tokenizer.json. fast tokenizer fails, slow loads but generation starts with <pad> occasionally.

raj: can you paste the loader log? curious whether added_fast was set or if tokenizer.json was dropped during packaging.

elaine: log snippet:
```
redwood.loader ERROR: fast tokenizer not found: tokenizer.json -> falling back to slow tokenizer
redwood.tokenizer WARN: special_tokens_map not present, using defaults -> <pad> used as bos for some prompts
ValueError: missing tokenizer.json in model dir: /mnt/models/phi-bert-vert/tokenizer.json
```

mike: ok this smells like HF repo that only checked in `tokenizer_config.json` + vocab files (vocab.json / merges) but not the single-file `tokenizer.json` used by `tokenizers` fast impl. HF often uses `added_tokens.json` and `tokenizer_config.json` to describe specials.

jess: quick workaround: you can synth a minimal `tokenizer.json` from the slow tokenizer via the tokenizers lib. eg:
```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/hf'); t.save('tokenizer.json')"
```
That made the fast path load for me locally.

elaine: tried that, fast path loads and generation looks correct. but we should make converter emit tokenizer.json to avoid manual steps. also chat templates reference special tokens in tokenizer_config.json -> we need to ensure mapping carried over.

raj: Agreed. Proposed fix for hf-converter: if `added_fast` or `tokenizer.json` absent, attempt to build tokenizer.json using `tokenizers` API and embed `special_tokens_map` from `tokenizer_config.json` into the resulting file. Also normalize `model_max_length` and `padding_side` into the metadata we ship. I'll draft a PR.

mike: small gotcha — some HF repos put `special_tokens_map` under `tokenizer_config.json` as `special_tokens_map` or `special_tokens`. Converter needs to check both and prefer explicit mappings over guesses. Also ensure chat-template fields in `tokenizer_config.json` (like `model_input_names`) are translated into Redwood's chat metadata.

ci-bot: CI triggered: hf-converter phi-bert-vert test -> build 4321 started. Will run unit tests + a quick generation smoke test with synth tokenizer.json.

jess: plan: canary the fixed converter + new model artifact to a tiny Dedicated pool, run our eval harness (S0/S1), and watch token-level regression alerts. :eyes:

elaine: action items: 1) @raj open PR to synth tokenizer.json + copy specials, 2) @jess add unit for special token preservation and chat-template mapping, 3) @mike add docs section on HF packaging expectations, 4) I'll run the canary tomorrow 09:00 PT and kick off quantization evals.

raj: will do. I'll include a small helper script in `tools/hf_converter` called `generate_tokenizer_json.py` and tests that operate on minimal HF dirs. :thumbsup:

mike: interim workaround for private/on-prem users: symlink `tokenizer_config.json` -> `tokenizer.json` in model dir before upload. Not perfect but unblocks.

elaine: great, thanks everyone — closing thread once PR lands and canary passes.
